summary: Bir bulut, üzerine yağan haber kartlarını çizer ve altında 'BİLGİ YAĞMURU' yazısı belirir.

anchor_words: Her gün yeni bir haber çıkıyor
scenes.visual: Transparent background, black marker strokes only, in a narrow column on the right edge of the frame (about x 1600 to 1900), clear of the centred speaker. At 0.24 s a cloud outline is drawn at the top of the column, in a few strokes. From 0.98 s ('haber') a small newspaper card is drawn under the cloud: a rectangle with a scribbled headline and two scribbled text lines. From 1.82 s ('Üzerimize') the card is followed by three more small cards and short slanted rain strokes. They are drawn one after another down the column, staggered at 2.42 s, 2.90 s and 3.20 s ('yağıyor bilgiler'). Each card has 45 degree hatching on one corner. Below the cards, a small stick figure holding a tiny umbrella is drawn, ending at 3.54 s. At 4.16 s ('sağanak') the handwritten words 'BİLGİ YAĞMURU' are written letter by letter from left to right under the figure, in two lines. At 4.90 s ('yağışı') a muted red underline is drawn under 'YAĞMURU'. At 5.36 s a small red arrow curves from the cloud down toward the figure. Drawn lines never move once drawn. End state: cloud, cards, figure, text and the red accents all stay on screen.
